concrete_prepared_artifact_findings.minimal_patch: Select cache bytes from precision["kv_cache_dtype"] with bfloat8_b -> BFP8_BYTES (1088/1024) and bfloat16 -> 2.0 bytes/element; use the selected value in BOTH KV read and write formulas. Keep weight-group accounting independent. Add host tests proving KV read/write ratio is 2/(1088/1024)=1.8823529411764706 for identical positions, and that total DRAM delta is only those KV terms; preserve current BFP8-KV equality.
